lead_raw_text:
The structure of Ca8Cu4Mo4O24 (reduced formula Ca2CuMoO6) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with 40 atoms per unit cell distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies octahedral Cu and Mo centers, each coordinated by six O neighbors, while Ca shows a close-packed-like local arrangement with 12 O neighbors. Corner-sharing between Cu and Mo octahedra is observed, alongside face-sharing between Ca and Cu polyhedra. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 40 sites.
